category: Elemental calculation / variant / unidentified time expression

problem: At U01803 the print distinguishes main sa ya bzhi from small gzhi yang byung. The lteb dang gtugs report has uncertain attachment. At U01811–U01812 the main verse reads lo stong zhag kyang 'bum phrag gsum; the small variant reads lo ste zhag kyang bcu phrag gsum yang byung. The entire U01829 expression is a small-print alternative beside the main U01830 wording. The stars' not being two and ascending/descending halves are not unambiguously explained.
treatment: Retain four million without inventing a unit, preserve the unattached report, and translate the main thousand-years/300,000-days statement without normalizing it to 360,000. Collect the cross-unit variant separately. Mark U01829 as a variant, not an extra main count. Preserve 180 without supplying days, and leave the half-cycle and star constructions provisional.
uncertainty: The gzhi replacement scope, lteb/gtugs attachment, intended year/day arithmetic, and the lunar-versus-annual scope of the halves remain unresolved despite clear typographical separation.
action: Check all calculation claims against the selected witness and document emendations separately. Apply the U01821–U01822 alignment corrections. The cropped scans establish typography, not the correctness of the arithmetic.

problem: The list relates winds, light, sounds, earthquakes, reflections and vanishing to weather, crops and social groups. sa g.yos mnyam and ri khri g.yo are unclear; ri khri could involve a throne designation or a numerical mountain construction. The text supplies no worked calculation.
treatment: Retain all phenomena, groups and harvests, leave evenness and mountain-throne visibly provisional, and do not turn the list into a contemporary weather, political or agricultural forecast.
uncertainty: The two compounds and the attachment of vanishing into space need source-based review. No predictive reliability is established by translation.
action: Resolve the glyphs and compounds with authorized witnesses or commentary, keeping any proposed reading outside the unchanged source.

category: Elemental bliss / relationship clauses / embodiment list / safety
problem: ngo che and ngo mi chogs frame the teaching through regard and inability to refuse. The mental-faculty-of-samsara clause, desired qualities, the two named embodiments, and freedom from sound before empowerment are compressed. The text explicitly describes cutting outer and inner breath flow.
treatment: Keep the relationship wording provisional, bracket the supplied orientation of mental faculty, retain only the two named embodiments, and do not replace freedom from sound with mastery of sound. Preserve the breath statement as source content with a visibly editorial instruction not to attempt breath cessation from this draft. Maintain meditative stabilization distinct from deep absorption.
uncertainty: Several clause attachments and the fifth neuter-empty referent remain unsettled. The text's liberation, lifespan and breath claims are not independently validated or approved as practical instructions.
action: Review the complete sensory-practice sequence and terminology before use; do not undertake hazardous breath restriction on the basis of this translation.

problem: The account distinguishes transferring into entities from emptiness. Its release/voice clause and invisible-form/all-bodies result are compressed. gzhon pa'i gzugs at U01932 gives a youthful-form reading, not an established mount reading. The source restricts taking material things to offerings for the guru.
treatment: Keep both types and every restriction, preserve basic space and dharma embodiment as distinct, and leave the youthful-form reading queried rather than silently changing gzhon to bzhon. Do not reconstruct an occult technique or endorse taking others' property. Apply the U01921–U01922 alignment correction.
uncertainty: The material-object referent, invisible form, youthful forms and entering ordinary mind require review. Transferring here is not automatically the same scope as the preceding spiritual transference category.
action: Resolve the lexical and grammatical questions from the source; retain the described acts as historical religious claims, not recommendations.

category: Transferring illness / insentient supports / restrictive condition
problem: rigs bcas sems kyi bsdus at U01939 leaves its attachment unclear. The source claims illness can be transferred to living beings and describes insentient supports and a series of operations; it later prohibits the efficacy of taking for personal worldly desire.
treatment: Preserve the unclear family/ordinary-mind construction, every support and operation, and the final negative condition. Bracket illness as the supplied object of release where implicit. Do not add an operational mechanism, claim that disease can actually be transferred by this method, or recommend harming others or appropriating property.
uncertainty: The family referent, the status of the listed signs, and the scope of the actual-release predicate remain provisional. No clinical or empirical verification has been performed.
action: Review the complete sequence and its limiting conditions philologically; do not apply the described acts as treatment or instructions for conduct.
